## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at s/n Calle de Bailén.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> After a quarter-century of construction, the state-of-the-art gallery finally emerges, proudly displaying great masterpieces alongside a remarkable discovery. Unveiling a section of the Moorish wall dating back to the city's foundation in the 9th century, the Royal Collections Gallery in Madrid now welcomes the eagerly-awaiting public.
>
> This cultural gem stands tall as one of Europe's finest highlights this year. Inside, visitors can explore an extensive collection of paintings, tapestries, sculptures, decorative art pieces, armory, and opulent royal furniture amassed by Spanish monarchs spanning five centuries. The items on display offer glimpses into the grandeur of the Spanish Empire during the Habsburg and Bourbon dynasties.
>
> But the real magic happens when you catch sight of the breathtaking landscape beyond. Offering panoramic views of Madrid's stunning cityscape, the vista from here is bound to leave you spellbound.
